philippines.title: PBA: Alec Stockton pushes Converge past TNT in OT thriller
philippines.description:
ANTIPOLO—Converge secured the No. 3 spot in Group A of the PBA Governors’ Cup after a thrilling 114-112 overtime victory over TNT on Sunday at Ynares Center here. Alec Stockton forced the extension with the tying basket, and his layup turned out to be the game-winner as the FiberXers rallied from 15 down to prevail in the contest that served as a prelude to what to expect in the playoffs. philippines.title: Pope Leo ready to gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
philippines.description:
VATICAN CITY (AP) — Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter’s Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized for an operation to remove a malignant tumor and said that he plans to gradually return to his usual duties. The crowd erupted in cheers when the pontiff showed himself in the window overlooking the square, where a week ago on the same occasion of the traditional Angelus blessing he revealed that a nodule had been located on his lung, and that it would be surgically removed. “Now that this delicate phase is behind me, I will […]...

philippines.title: Davidovich Fokina beats Rafael Jodar to win Shanghai Masters
philippines.description:
SHANGHAI — Alejandro Davidovich Fokina rallied from a set and a break down to beat Rafael Jodar 1-6, 7-6 (5), 6-4 and win the Shanghai Masters on Sunday, securing his third title of the year and biggest yet of his career. The 25th-seeded Spaniard had lost the first five finals of his career, including the Monte Carlo Masters in 2022. His other titles this year came on grass in Mallorca in June and at the Chengdu Open in China last month. Both were ATP 250 tournaments.
